outputs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: 3D modelling reference sheet for one used ordinary Korean cotton knit work glove. Attached photo is construction reference only: five separate knitted fingers, simple ribbed wrist cuff, no logos, no rubber coating. Create ONE same glove shown in three consistent views: directly overhead lying flat, low three-quarter view, underside. Off-white cotton slightly grey from handling with a few believable dried white gypsum smears across palm/fingers, fine stockinette loops rather than leather or padded armor. The glove is empty, relaxed and thin, about 24cm long, fingers gently bent and loosely separated, not filled with an invisible hand. A dark grey overlock thread around cuff opening, cuff visibly hollow. Soft neutral diffuse daylight on plain middle grey background; useful actual photographic detail, no lettering/captions, no horror, no human body or mannequin. Precise natural proportions from reference. Keep finger count exactly five.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless 1024 square albedo texture for a 3D cotton work glove. Match the ordinary white cotton knit in the reference image. Fill the entire frame with evenly spaced fine stockinette cotton knitting, slightly uneven off-white / warm pale grey yarn fibers, restrained grey handling dirt and a very few tiny dried gypsum deposits. No glove outline, no fingers, no background, no perspective, no directional lighting, no shadows, no highlights, no text. Flat orthographic close-up surface only, tile seamlessly at all edges. Physically plausible 7-gauge machine-knit loops, each small V stitch readable; not woven canvas, not chainmail, not leather. Uniform diffuse light. Enough small variations to avoid machine-perfect rows, but no large stains or mottled noise.
